question: Should this route replacement merge before the production signing secret, matching OpenClaw public trust root, and end-to-end deployment proof are ready together?
rationale: The patch intentionally makes the existing public route fail closed and establishes a production content-trust boundary; automation cannot choose the acceptable rollout order or outage window.

options.title: Coordinate Producer And Trust Root
options.body: Provision a test or production-equivalent atomic secret, land the matching OpenClaw public key behavior, capture end-to-end proof, and then merge and deploy together.

options.title: Merge But Hold Deployment
options.body: Merge the implementation while explicitly preventing production backend deployment until the secret and consumer trust root are ready.

options.title: Pause For Companion Stack
options.body: Keep this PR open until the OpenClaw consumer and RFC direction are settled enough to validate the complete trust path.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Producer And Trust Root
recommendation.body: Provision a test or production-equivalent atomic secret, land the matching OpenClaw public key behavior, capture end-to-end proof, and then merge and deploy together.
